spring-pulse.$description: Spring Pulse — Primary action buttons, active states, the single chromatic accent — a high-chroma lime-green that reads as switched-on against the black canvas

void.$description: Void — Page canvas, hero background, deepest surface — the negative space everything floats on

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Elevated surface, button fills, subtle card backgrounds — one step off true black to distinguish interactive elements

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card surfaces, body text on light flips, icon fills — the workhorse dark for contained components

bone.$description: Bone — Headline text, body text on dark canvas, nav fill, button fills on dark — maximum-contrast white that never competes with the green accent

ash.$description: Ash — Card borders, hairline dividers on dark — barely visible structural lines

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted body text, secondary copy, placeholder — readable but recedes

fog.$description: Fog — Subtle borders, disabled strokes, soft separators

taupe.$description: Taupe — Footer dividers, warm-neutral hairline accents

sand.$description: Sand — Warm off-white for inverted button fills or light-section surfaces

slate.$description: Slate — Deep body text, pressed states

iris.$description: Iris — Outlined-link borders, image accent strokes — the cool violet used for secondary chromatic borders

amethyst.$description: Amethyst — Outlined-link borders, body text accents — a warmer violet paired with Iris for link systems

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Link borders, hover-stroke accents — the deeper blue for interactive outlines

tide.$description: Tide — Single-card background highlight, occasional surface wash — the teal that appears as a breathing accent

saffron.$description: Saffron — Icon accents, body emphasis, warm stroke highlights — a yellow punctuation color used at micro scale

times-system.$description: Captions, micro-meta text — the system serif fallback for fine print that should feel editorial, not utilitarian

affinity-serif-variable.$description: Display headlines only. The signature element — tight 0.96–1.10 line-height lets descenders nearly touch the line below, creating an editorial poster feel. The italic 'all' in headlines is the brand's voice. At 112px with weight 400 it whispers authority; the type is the artwork.

canva-sans.$description: All UI, body, nav, buttons, subheads. The neutral workhorse with a subtle 0.01em tracking that gives it a slightly airy feel without feeling loose. Weight 500 for subheads, 600–700 for nav and button text.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
